# MD2PDF

> Free online Markdown to PDF converter. Convert .md files to styled PDFs, HTML, and images with 11 visual styles, Mermaid diagrams, auto table of contents, and syntax highlighting for 180+ languages. No signup; conversion runs entirely in the browser, and share links are end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before upload. Agents share documents with the md2pdf-studio CLI (npm), its MCP server, or an installable AI skill for Claude, Codex and other agents.

Last updated: 2026-11-10

## Main

- [MD2PDF App](https://md2pdf.studio/): Online Markdown editor with live preview, 11 visual styles, Mermaid diagrams, TOC, and export to PDF/HTML/image
- [About MD2PDF](https://md2pdf.studio/about): Background, features, and how it works
- [Full AI Documentation](https://md2pdf.studio/llms-full.txt): Complete reference for LLMs — features, CLI, MCP server, AI skill, styles, and usage

## For agents

- [md2pdf-studio CLI and MCP server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/md2pdf-studio): `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.2 share file.md` encrypts locally and prints the private link; also update, delete, list, `--expires`, `--burn` (one-time links), and an MCP server (`mcp`). Run it through npx with the exact version.
- [AI Skill](https://md2pdf.studio/skill.md): A fixed skill file for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and compatible agents, pinned to the CLI version
- [Install guide](https://md2pdf.studio/ai-skill): Claude Code, claude.ai (ZIP), AGENTS.md and MCP configuration
- [How links work](https://md2pdf.studio/api): What is encrypted on the device and what reaches the server

## Styles

- [Style Gallery](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/): Browse all 11 visual styles with previews and use cases
- [Notion](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/notion): Clean modern sans-serif (default)
- [GitHub](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/github): Classic GitHub markdown rendering
- [LaTeX](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/latex): Academic paper typography
- [Dracula](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/dracula): Vibrant dark theme
- [Terminal](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/terminal): Green-on-black monospace
- [All styles...](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/): Minimal, Academic, Corporate, Newspaper, Handwritten, Pastel
